external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Yachad and Camp Stone Partner to Create Staff Jobs for Individuals with Special Needs
For Camp Stone, a popular Orthodox Jewish summer camp in western Pennsylvania, this partnership is significant, as it continues the strong partnership between Yachad and Bnei Akiva affiliated camps.

Parents of participants in previous years raved about the program. “My son’s experience this summer in the Yachad vocational program in camp Mesorah was nothing short of ‘amazing’!” said one mother. “He felt that he truly ‘belonged’ in camp Mesorah and was well accepted by all. Ari, the camp director had a way of making everyone feel genuinely welcomed, and Chani, the Yachad director, made all the members an integral part of everyday life in camp. Thank you to everyone- it was a fantastic summer
